text: Which airline AI initiatives should leadership hold until evidence improves?
claudePromptBoundary: Full production prompt is reconstructed from current source template and captured source packet. ai_egress_audit stores prompt hash/snapshot refs, not raw prompt text by default.
claudeResponse:
Airline Demo has eight active AI initiatives in the IROPS and recovery portfolio, and my read is that at least four of them should be held — not cancelled, but explicitly gated — until data certification, control evidence, and adoption proof are in hand.
The ones ready to scale are the bounded assists with human-in-loop workflow already designed. The ones that need to wait are the autonomous or passenger/crew-impacting agents where the governance controls still show open gaps. The governance ledger loaded from Airline Demo's context is the tell here.
Evidence control 43 (AI governance domain) is in gap status, owned by the Chief Safety Officer. Audit control 41 (privacy domain) is in review-required status.
Those two open controls alone are enough to hold any initiative that touches passenger itinerary data or crew legality decisions — which covers the Passenger Reaccommodation Agent, the Crew Recovery Copilot, and the Customer Disruption Communication Agent. The data certification picture compounds the hold case.
Crew legality feeds, PNR reservation events, and the operational event store all require owner-signed freshness and lineage before they can support reliable model outputs. Until VP Data Platforms signs off on those feeds, any AI sitting on top of them is operating on unvalidated substrate.
Here is the initiative-level posture table: Initiative Portfolio — Hold / Scale Posture | Initiative | Impact / Value | Owner | Dependency / Risk | Posture |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IROPS Decision Assistant | High — faster recovery decisions across aircraft, crew, airport turns | EVP Operations | Operational event store freshness not certified; model-risk tier pending | Scale bounded (human-in-loop advisory only) |
| Crew Recovery Copilot | High — crew legality resolution speed | VP Crew Operations | Crew legality feed certification open; Evidence control 43 in gap | Hold — data and control gates open |
| Passenger Reaccommodation Agent | High — passenger recovery and cost avoidance | VP Digital Products | PNR/reservation event lineage not certified; autonomous action risk; DOT consumer control active | Hold — autonomous action requires HITL approval first |
| Customer Disruption Communication Agent | Medium — customer experience, DOT obligation alignment | VP Digital Products | DOT Approval control 38 effective, but audit control 41 in review; passenger data dependency | Hold — audit control must close before production |
| Flight Delay Root-Cause Assistant | Medium — OCC situational awareness | EVP Operations | Flight status feed dependency; advisory only so lower governance bar | Scale bounded — advisory posture reduces hold threshold |
| Baggage Recovery Prediction | Medium — baggage cost avoidance | VP Digital Products | Baggage scan event integration; lower crew/passenger impact | Sequence — fund after event store stabilizes |
| Airport Turn Risk Predictor | Medium — turn reliability, delay prevention | COO (Airport Ops) | Airport turn management capability rated mature; gate event data quality | Scale bounded — capability maturity supports it |
| Maintenance Delay Prediction | Medium — MRO cost and AOG avoidance | President TechOps | MRO predictive maintenance rated early-stage; maintenance delay feed dependency | Hold — capability maturity is early-stage; sequence after data foundation | The short version: IROPS Decision Assistant, Flight Delay Root-Cause Assistant, and Airport Turn Risk Predictor can move forward in bounded, advisory modes today.
Crew Recovery Copilot, Passenger Reaccommodation Agent, Customer Disruption Communication Agent, and Maintenance Delay Prediction should be held at gate until the specific evidence gaps close. Baggage Recovery Prediction sequences naturally after the operational event store is stabilized.
